messages.text: Fery's dreams of maiden ATP Tour title ended in Winston-Salem Open final

metadata.summary: Arthur Fery's hopes of landing his maiden ATP Tour title at Winston-Salem Open was ended in emphatic fashion by Peruvian Ignacio Buse on Saturday.
metadata.content: Arthur Fery: Brits hopes of landing maiden ATP Tour title at Winston-Salem Open ended by Peruvian Ignacio Buse with US Open starting Sunday | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content Arthur Fery: Brits hopes of landing maiden ATP Tour title at Winston-Salem Open ended by Peruvian Ignacio Buse with US Open starting Sunday Britain's Arthur Fery beaten in straight-sets by Peruvian Ignacio Buse in Winston-Salem Open final; watch the US Open from Sunday live on Sky Sports Tennis and Sky Sports+, streaming service NOW and the Sky Sports app Saturday 29 August 2026 23:26, UK Image: Arthur Fery was soundly beaten by Peruvian Ignacio Buse in the Winston-Salem Open final on Saturday Arthur Fery's hopes of landing his maiden ATP Tour title at Winston-Salem Open was ended in emphatic fashion by Peruvian Ignacio Buse on Saturday. From 3-3 in the first set, Fery lost six straight games before eventually going down 6-3 6-2 to Buse. The promising 22-year-old clinched his second trophy of the season having lifted his maiden tour-level trophy at the ATP 500 event in Hamburg. messages.text: Hrgovic stuns Itauma with epic comeback as Brit loses unbeaten record

metadata.summary: Filip Hrgovic produced one of the shocks of the boxing year, stopping an exhausted Moses Itauma in the ninth round at The O2 to win the vacant IBF heavyweight title and become Croatia's first world heavyweight champion.
metadata.content: Filip Hrgovic stuns Moses Itauma with epic comeback as British heavyweight star loses unbeaten record | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Filip Hrgovic stuns Moses Itauma with epic comeback as British heavyweight star loses unbeaten record Filip Hrgovic stopped Moses Itauma in the ninth round in one of the biggest shocks of the boxing year in London, with the 21-year-old paying the price for emptying his tank as Hrgovic became Croatia’s first-ever world heavyweight champion Stuart Hodge @Hodgeythehack Sunday 30 August 2026 00:25, UK Image: Filip Hrgovic defeated Moses Itauma in London Filip Hrgovic produced one of the shocks of the boxing year, stopping an exhausted Moses Itauma in the ninth round at The O2 to win the vacant IBF heavyweight title and become Croatia's first world heavyweight champion. Itauma, unbeaten coming into the fight and one of the sport's most talked about young talents, had started like a man intent on an early night and for six rounds barely lost a minute. messages.text: De Zerbi highlights biggest problem at Spurs as Carra slams 'worst start'

metadata.summary: Roberto De Zerbi believes changing the mentality at Tottenham is his biggest challenge after Sky Sports' Jamie Carragher said their start to the season "couldn't have gone any worse" following defeat to Newcastle.
metadata.content: Tottenham Hotspur: Roberto De Zerbi highlights biggest problem at Spurs after Newcastle defeat as Jamie Carragher slams start | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Tottenham Hotspur: Roberto De Zerbi highlights biggest problem at Spurs after Newcastle defeat as Jamie Carragher slams start Spurs have lost both of their opening Premier League games without scoring, having finished the past two seasons in 17th place; Tottenham have spent £320m this transfer window; Jamie Carragher reckons more business to come; Roberto De Zerbi believes project will come good Sunday 30 August 2026 00:29, UK Image: Spurs forward Omar Marmoush shows the strain during defeat to Newcastle Roberto De Zerbi believes changing the mentality at Tottenham is his biggest challenge after Sky Sports' Jamie Carragher said their start to the season "couldn't have gone any worse" following defeat to Newcastle. Tottenham have lost their first two Premier League games without scoring a goal and sit at the bottom of the league despite spending £320m in the transfer market this summer. De Zerbi's side had been better than Newcastle until Anthony Elanga struck the opener midway through the second half, with Spurs unable to respond and conceding another when Yoane Wissa hooked in from close range. messages.text: Europa League and Conference League fixtures confirmed

metadata.summary: Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Bournemouth, Brighton, Celtic and Hearts have learned the details of their Europa League and Conference League fixtures this season.
metadata.content: Europa League and Conference League: Fixtures for Celtic, Bournemouth, Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Brighton and Hearts confirmed | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Europa League and Conference League: Fixtures for Celtic, Bournemouth, Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Brighton and Hearts confirmed Celtic, Sunderland, Bournemouth and Crystal Palace will compete in the Europa League; Brighton and Hearts are in the Conference League; Europa League league phase begins on September 15 with Conference League on October 15 Saturday 29 August 2026 21:42, UK Image: Europa League and Conference League trophies Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Bournemouth, Brighton, Celtic and Hearts have learned the details of their Europa League and Conference League fixtures this season. The league-phase draws for both competitions were made on Friday, with Europa League clubs set to play eight matches, while Conference League sides will play six - an equal number home and away - between September 2026 and January 2027. Sunderland reached Europe for the first time in 53 years and will travel to the San Siro to face AC Milan, while Bournemouth , in their first European competition, will also host the Italian club.
